g.title: det1
g.text: jwst Detector1: ramps to count rate

g.title: bkg1
g.text: detector background, fitted outside the traces, removed:

g.title: geo
g.text: footprint of every commanded slitlet and

g.title: spec2
g.text: jwst Spec2, one run per rate file, stuck shutters closed:
WCS, flat field, path loss, flux and wavelength calibration
extend_g140m_g235m = false (G140M / G235M past the red end)

g.title: mb1
g.text: background spectrum from the empty shutters;

g.title: tmap
g.text: each pixel (kept in the rate file)

g.title: sfit
g.text: fitted; stuck when < 0.3 over nods and detectors

g.title: mb2
g.text: clean empty shutters reselected; background spectrum
(the exposure group's pool unless an exposure differs)

g.title: joint
g.text: first pass: every source solved together with the
sources whose light shares its pixels (trace maps)

g.title: units
g.text: units fixed where jwst found no source

g.title: nbr
g.text: other catalog sources placed along the slitlet in every nod;
their brightness against the master background

g.title: paint
g.text: master background on the detector, through every

g.title: pick
g.text: background nods of each exposure: a nod is left out
when a bright neighbor sits where the source is

g.title: sub
g.text: path loss undone, background nods subtracted

g.title: spec3
g.text: jwst Spec3: exposures rectified and combined;

g.title: pfit
g.text: one spectrum fitted to every nod difference:
Gaussian galaxy x PSF, clipped by the shutters

g.title: dmap
g.text: pixel map: the product's grid and each exposure's
mapping onto it, built once; PROF2D, CONTAM2D
and the master-background 2-D are drizzled through it

g.title: mbs
g.text: master-background spectrum: calibrated cutouts minus their
master background (_mbkg.fits), in memory; bad pixels = Spec3's
outlier flags + hot pixels; drizzled through the pixel map;
the same fit at the nodded shape, light through
failed-open shutters solved with the source

g.title: redo
g.text: neighbor check of stage 2b redone with each neighbor's
modeled brightness; sources whose background nods
change go through stage 2b and Spec3 again

g.title: shape
g.text: source shape: own fit above the detection gate,
else the PRISM shape (gratings), else the default

g.title: contam
g.text: other sources' light on the source

g.title: scan
g.text: search for uncataloged neighbors in the residuals;
proposed background-nod changes, applied by stage 2b
on its next run with scan_action = "auto_override"

g.title: spec
g.text: 2-D spectrum, PROF2D, CONTAM2D; SPEC1D_MBKG and its 2-D

g.title: zfit
g.text: templates fitted over a grid of redshifts

g.title: lines
g.text: line fluxes at the inspected redshift

g.title: k_opt
g.text: step an option turns on or off
